title: HR Estimate Review
description: View per-category policy caps on the new /hr/cases/:caseId/estimate page. Linked from each case's Budget overview in the Command Center.

title: LLM-assisted policy extraction
description: Upload an HR policy PDF or DOCX and let Claude pull out benefits side-by-side with the regex baseline. HR reviews and confirms before any data is saved.

title: Destination coverage expanded to 25 countries
description: Added France, Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, Sweden, Denmark, Ireland, Poland, Mexico, and China to the destination picker.

title: Employee case fetch fixed
description: GET /api/cases now returns 200 with the employee's assigned cases instead of 404. The Employee Portal loads case data again.

title: Consistent breadcrumbs across the platform
description: All 11 audited pages now show a 3-segment breadcrumb (ReloPass / Section / Page) inline above the H1.
